name: Supervisor
notes: Room Supervisor. Observes the Lead, routes Human intent, bounded recovery. Never does project work, never directs Peers.

name: Lead (Astra)
notes: Room Lead. Owns technical decisions, dispatches Peers, accepts or rejects candidates. One Lead per project.

name: Lead (Sol 6.1)
notes: Room Lead on Codex gpt-6.1-sol (trial). Same authority as the other Lead seats; one Lead per project.

name: Lead (Opus)
notes: Room Lead on Claude Opus 5.5, for demanding projects. Same authority as Lead (Astra); one Lead per project.

name: Peer
notes: Room Peer. Owns exactly one bounded outcome from the Lead (writable, or a read-only review). Created only by the Lead.
